svg.title: Provider-neutral AI consumption governance flow
svg.desc: Seven numbered process bands show owned scope, authoritative evidence, completeness decisions, four configurable governance layers, validation, approval, pilot, staged rollout, monitoring, escalation, reconciliation, exceptions, rollback, redesign, and recurring review.
